description: A window comparator joined to a stepped voltage accumulator: every trigger adds one step to a running voltage, and the comparator turns that voltage around at the edges of the window

params.text: Sets the centre of the comparator window, -5V to 5V
Sets the width of the comparator window, 0 to 10V, with its edges half that far above and below the centre
Sets how far the running voltage moves on each trigger, -1V to 1V
Attenuverts the bias CV before it is added to the bias knob
Attenuverts the range CV before it is added to the range knob
Attenuverts the step size CV before it is added to the step knob
Attenuverts the voltage arriving at the comparator input
Adds one step to the running voltage on each press, for every polyphonic channel at once
Sets the running voltage back to the bias voltage on each press, or back to 0V while a cable is in the comparator input

inputs.text: A voltage compared against the window in place of the module's own running voltage; patching it stops the comparator from turning that voltage around at the window edges
Shifts the centre of the window, added to the bias knob through its attenuverter and clamped to -10 to 10V
Widens or narrows the window, added to the range knob through its attenuverter; the total is taken as an absolute value and clamped to 10V
A high gate reverses the sign of the step, so the running voltage climbs instead of falling
Changes the step size, added to the step knob through its attenuverter and clamped to -5 to 5V
A rising edge adds one step to the running voltage
A rising edge sets the running voltage back to the bias voltage, or to 0V while a cable is in the comparator input

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the compared voltage is above the top edge of the window, and 0V otherwise
Carries 10V while the compared voltage is below the bottom edge of the window, and 0V otherwise
The running voltage, clamped to -10 to 10V, and snapped to the grid picked under Quantization

notes: nothing moves until a trigger arrives, either at the TRIG. input or from the button; the voltage then walks one step per trigger and turns around at the window edges
menu: Poly Channel Count — a slider fixing how many polyphonic channels are run, from Auto, which takes the count from the trigger and comparator inputs, up to 16
Quantization — snaps the stepper output to equal divisions of a volt: None (default), Octaves at 1-EDO, or 9, 12, 17, 19, 22, 24, 31, 41 and 53-EDO
Invert Input Mode: Momentary, Latch — Momentary reverses the step while the gate is above 0V; Latch flips the direction on each rise past 1V and holds it there

inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.3:
high above 0V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
